diff_summary: Hardened backend and frontend Dockerfiles with multi-stage builds and non-root users (app:10001 and nextjs:1001). Added container HEALTHCHECK and compose healthcheck for backend /health/live, and set frontend depends_on condition to service_healthy.

verification.command: docker compose config && PYTHONPATH=backend:. APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_contract_snapshot.py backend/tests/test_route_registration.py backend/tests/test_simulation_replay.py backend/tests/test_api.py -k "test_runtime_route_registrations or test_current_openapi or test_websocket_bus or f_dom_05 or test_app_lifespan or test_restarting_simulator" && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/mypy --strict backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app
